name: Ecchi na Himitsu Kichi
source:
"Can I call you oniichan?"

I met petite twin tail Kotone one summer vacation in the country.
Every day we played together.

"Kotone-chan, I'll teach you about my secret fort."

That special place marks the first of many inappropriate days!!

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ106618.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
“我可以叫你哥哥吗？”

暑假在乡下遇见了娇小的双马尾琴音。
每天我们都在一起玩。

“琴音酱，我来教你关于我的秘密要塞的知识。”

那个特殊的地方标志着许多不适当的日子的第一天！
